Market today: The mood is cautious, with oil easing on geopolitical talks. For your tech/chip-heavy, margin-fueled book, this means volatility is still the name of the game.

Your holdings: SMCI (-24.7%), METU (-13.08%), MUU (-29.98%), SOXL (-58.67%), and SPAL (-36.5%) are all marked SELL and are deep in the red. These leveraged ETFs and SMCI are the main concerns, amplified by margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader semiconductor ETF SOXL and the leveraged tech ETFs like MUU and METU. Their continued weakness is a drag.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your losing leveraged positions and SMCI before they cause more pain.
plays: Trim SOXL, METU, MUU, SMCI: These are deep losses, especially leveraged ones. Consider cutting exposure to stop further margin calls.
Consider trimming SPAL: Down 36.5%, this leveraged ETF is also a significant loser. Evaluate if the risk is worth the potential reward.
No new buys today - hold and watch
